tools.name: conceptio_search
tools.description: Search the open-access archive — papers, technical standards (NIST, OWASP, CISA), textbooks, and legal sources (EUR-Lex, HUDOC) with license-aware access. Requires an API key: run `conceptio auth` once first. Query supports directives like 'source:nist zero trust'.

query.description: Search keywords or directives (e.g. 'source:nist zero trust')

category.description: Optional category filter: 'Science & Medicine', 'Economics & Finance', 'Computer Science & Tech', 'Social Sciences & Humanities', 'Arts & Culture', 'Law & Regulation'

license.description: Optional rights filter requiring explicit commercial-use permission.

tools.name: conceptio_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a known identifier straight to its document(s) in the archive: an RFC number ('RFC 2119'), a DOI ('doi:10.1109/access.2020.2986772'), an arXiv ID ('2604.08499'), a PubMed ID ('PMID 41961061'), a PubMed Central ID ('PMC10601397'), a NIST/FIPS designation ('NIST FIPS 199'), a W3C spec shortname ('w3c_digital-credentials'), or a US legal citation / docket ('347 U.S. 483', '20-5364'). Unrecognized identifiers fall back to a text search. Use this when an agent has a concrete citation/reference it wants to locate precisely.

tools.name: conceptio_download_pdf
tools.description: Download the original open-access PDF of a paper, standard, or book to a local file path. Accepts a Conceptio document ID (from conceptio_search) or a direct PDF URL.

doc_id_or_url.description: Conceptio document ID (digits) or direct PDF URL

tools.name: conceptio_get_citation
tools.description: Get an academic citation for a document in BibTeX, APA, MLA, or Chicago format.

tools.name: conceptio_search_batch
tools.description: Run multiple independent searches in one call. Default: queue 1–50 for bounded background execution and return an opaque job handle (poll it with the public API or `conceptio search-job`). Set sync:true to run 1–10 immediately and return all results in one response — each fresh subquery uses one search credit either way.

queries.description: Search objects with q and optional sources, category, language, sort, limit, and offset

sync.description: Run synchronously (1–10 queries, results in one call) instead of queueing a job

tools.name: conceptio_connectors_send
tools.description: Save one document to Zotero or open a metadata-only Obsidian handoff. Server-side ownership, connector trial, and failure semantics apply.

connector.description: Target connector: 'zotero' saves the document, 'obsidian' opens a metadata-only handoff.

tools.name: conceptio_connectors_send_all
tools.description: Bulk-save selected documents to Zotero. Pro, institutional, or licensed access is required; no free trial path.

connector.description: Target connector — only 'zotero' supports bulk saves.

tools.name: conceptio_get_document
tools.description: Fetch complete metadata (title, author, source, license, description, direct PDF URL) for a document ID.

tools.name: conceptio_graph_walk
tools.description: Walk the reference graph from one seed source_id — the compliance walk: what that document cites (direction='out'), what cites it (direction='in'), or both. Optional kind filter selects cites/updates. Returns nodes with a distance from the seed and canonical edges carrying their relation kinds; dangling targets appear as claimed nodes. Metadata-only: spends no credits. Use when an agent needs provenance — what cites this regulation two hops out — instead of a keyword search.

seed.description: Archive source_id to start the walk from (e.g. 'usc_42_1396a')

direction.description: out = what the seed cites, in = what cites the seed, both = either

hops.description: Traversal depth (1 or 2); the server caps the walk here

kind.description: Relation kind(s) to traverse; pass several to intersect them
